title: UI semantic ISA: one vocabulary for rv2-ui and its apps
description: Implement docs/architecture/003-ui-semantic-isa.md (UI1–UI9). Apps state intent through registers (tokens), operands (enums) and instructions (components); rv2-ui is the only place that emits classes. Children are ordered by dependency: foundations, then operands/instructions, then composites, then app migrations, then the xtask rule that locks it in.
acceptance_criteria: All children closed; 003 marked Accepted; `cargo xtask ci` enforces UI7.
